newsitem.title: USA: Scios to seek Auriculin approval in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Scios to seek Auriculin approval in 1997.

text.p: Scios Inc this year will file a new drug application (NDA) with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for its Auriculin treatment for acute renal failure, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Casey said on Wednesday.
Auriculin is being developed in collaboration with Genentech Inc.

Speaking at the Hambrecht and Quist Healthcare Conference in San Francisco, Casey also said Scios this year would complete Phase III trials of Natrecor BNP, a recombinant version of a natural hormone designed to treat acute congestive heart failure.
He said Scios planned to file a new drug application for Natrecor in early 1998.
